## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 406 captures during July 2025. Activity was completed in line with the reporting requirements for the month. The recorded volume provides the basis for the image-quality review and subsequent grading outcomes. No additional activity information was reported for this period.

## Image quality

There were 21 ungradable images, representing an ungradable rate of 5.2 per cent. These images could not be assessed for grading purposes. The ungradable results should continue to be monitored through routine quality review so that any recurring issues can be identified and addressed. Staff raised no new equipment faults during the month.

## Grading

Grading identified 122 referable results. The median lag between image capture and grading was 1 day. This indicates that the central point of the grading process remained timely during July 2025. The referable results should be managed through the established clinical follow-up arrangements, with outcomes monitored as part of routine service oversight. Overall, the reported activity, image quality and grading measures provide a summary of site operations at Harbour Eye Clinic for the month.
